stem: A query counts transactions in 5-minute windows with withWatermark("event_time", "15 minutes") in append mode. The latest event_time seen so far is 10:18. Has the window 10:00-10:05 been written to the sink?
choices: Yes. A window is written as soon as its end time has passed in wall-clock time
Not yet. The watermark is 10:03, which is still before the window's end at 10:05
Yes. The watermark is 10:18, past the window end
No. Append mode writes windows only when the stream stops
explanation_ja: ウォーターマーク = 見た中で最大の event_time − 遅延許容 = 10:18 − 15分 = 10:03。枠の終わり 10:05 をまだ越えていないので、append モードでは書き出されません。基準は時計の時刻ではなくデータの event_time です。

stem: You join a stream of card transactions with a stream of fraud alerts on card_id, where an alert arrives within 10 minutes of its transaction. What keeps the join state from growing without limit?
choices: Broadcasting the alerts stream
Using outputMode("complete")
A watermark on the transactions stream only
Watermarks on both streams plus an event-time range condition in the join
explanation_ja: ストリーム同士の結合では、両側にウォーターマークを付け、結合条件に時間の範囲(例: alert_time BETWEEN txn_time AND txn_time + 10分)を入れると、古い状態を捨てられます。片側だけでは相手側の状態が残り続けます。

stem: Inside foreachBatch, each micro-batch is appended to two Delta tables. After a failure the same batch may be replayed. How do you avoid writing it twice?
choices: Pass txnAppId and txnVersion = batchId as write options on each Delta write
Give each inner write its own checkpointLocation
Call batch_df.cache() before writing
Switch the stream to trigger(once=True)
explanation_ja: Delta は txnAppId と txnVersion の組を覚えていて、同じ組の書き込みが来たらスキップします。batchId を txnVersion に使えば、再実行しても二重に書かれません。cache は重複を防ぎません。

stem: A running aggregation grouped by account_id is changed to group by account_id, channel. You restart it with the same checkpoint. What happens?
choices: It continues, and the new key applies only to new data
Databricks migrates the state to the new keys automatically
It fails or gives wrong results, because the saved state no longer matches the query. Start it with a new checkpoint (and reprocess if needed)
It runs, but the output switches to complete mode
explanation_ja: 集計のキーを変えると、チェックポイントに保存された状態の形と合わなくなります。この変更は同じチェックポイントでは再開できないので、新しいチェックポイントで始めます。トリガー間隔やレート制限の変更は問題ありません。

stem: The view main.risk.v_daily_exposure, owned by risk-admins, reads main.core.loans. Analysts have USE CATALOG, USE SCHEMA and SELECT on the view only. What happens when an analyst queries the view?
choices: It fails; analysts also need SELECT on main.core.loans
It succeeds, because access to main.core.loans is checked against the view owner risk-admins
It succeeds, but the rows from main.core.loans are masked
It fails unless the view is converted to a materialized view
explanation_ja: ビューの元テーブルへの権限は、ビューの所有者(ここでは risk-admins)で確認されます。使う人にはビューの SELECT と、親の USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA があれば十分です。
